section1_below_ground.method: numpy default_rng(20261017); 1,000 draws uniform in latitude and in longitude (not by area) per box. Frame box 43.0-50.5 N, 118.5-101.0 W (website/gridded.py:38). View box 44.35-49.01 N, 116.06-104.03 W (D-G3). Towns: the 14 entries of website/towns.json. Ground elevation: AWS Terrain Tiles terrarium PNG, https://s3.amazonaws.com/elevation-tiles-prod/terrarium/{z}/{x}/{y}.png, decoded as R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768 (m), nearest pixel of 256 px tiles. Format per research/globe/validation-evidence/terrain.json. A MRMS level at H m above mean sea level is below ground where ground elevation > H, so the below-ground share of the 0.50, 0.75, 1.00 and 1.50 km levels equals the share of points above 500, 750, 1000 and 1500 m. The frame box is not Montana only; it includes parts of neighbouring states.

zoom9.ci_note: Binomial normal approximation, 1.96 x sqrt(p(1-p)/n). Sampling error only; the 500 m share in the view box is 1.0 at the point estimate, so the rule-of-three upper bound on the share not above 500 m is 0.003.

section1_below_ground.towns_note: The below-ground lists are the same at zoom 9 and zoom 10 for all 14 towns. Town values are single nearest-pixel samples at the towns.json coordinates.

ncep_code_table_4_106.quote_heading: GRIB2 - CODE TABLE 4.106 | Radar Data Quality Flags | Created 09/11/2025
notes_as_printed: (1)  'Undetected' means that the received radar signal is at or below noise level.
(2)  'No data' describes that a data point is out of range or in a blanked sector.
ncep_code_table_4_106.reading: A quality-flag table with codes 0 to 255, not the reflectivity fill convention. Its note numbers disagree with the table references: the table points 'No data' to Note 1, but Note 1 defines 'Undetected'. It does not say what -99 or -999 mean in MergedReflectivityQC.

ncep_mrms_v12_1_supplemental.grep_terms: missing, no coverage, no data, fill, -999, -99, coverage, sentinel
ncep_mrms_v12_1_supplemental.matches: No definition of -99 or -999. Table 11 background-value changes only: 'GRIB2: -99.9 to -1' (RadarAccumulatedQualityInd, Guam and Hawaii rows) and 'GRIB2: -99.9 to -3' (RadarOnly_QPE_15M,[03,06,12,24]H).
ncep_mrms_v12_1_supplemental.related_line: 'There are 33 2D MergedReflectivityQC products (one per vertical level of the MRMS 3D reflectivity mosaic).'

secondary_unverified: Earlier summary recorded in mrms.json (Unidata issue 1050): '2018 GRIB2 MergedBaseReflectivityQC: missing -99, no coverage -999 (secondary)'.

Search summary this session of the same issue: the NetCDF header declares missing_value -99 and _FillValue -999 (base variant, 2018 sample). This is a different reading of the same codes, and the direct GET returned HTTP 403.
Search result for a third-party README (mrms2gempak; not fetched): -3 flags points outside radar coverage and -999 denotes missing values. Not used.
section2_mrms_minus99_minus999.conclusion: Not settled. Keep 'No radar data' for -99 and -999 (D-G13 default) until the NSSL table or an NCEP definition is read. Do not adopt the -3 coverage claim or either secondary reading.
